description: 350W Motor Capacity 36V 10Ah Battery Capacity 20Mph Maximum Speed 5-6Hours Charging Time 40Miles Range 264Lbs Max Load Meet the Newest Urban e-bike: RACE This urban and commuter ebike equipped with 36V/10Ah (360Wh) batteries is built for the daily routine and city scene, which make it easier to haul, easier to commute. Plenty for a day’s adventure or most trips to travel and back. Remove the battery with the key and charge it at your home or office conveniently. 40 Miles Per Charge 5-6 Hours To Fully Charge 360 Wh Total Battery Capacity Multifunction Display Backlight display provides speed, mileage, power, etc information. Battery Capacity A fuel gauge for your electrons. Odometer Calculate how many miles you ride.
